title: Workplace Relations Legislation Amendment (Clearing the Fair Work Commission Backlog) Bill 2026
short_title: Workplace Relations Legislation Amendment (Clearing the Fair Work Commission Backlog) Bill 2026

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would change Fair Work Commission procedures, supported bargaining, road transport contractor protections and administration of construction industry bodies under federal workplace laws.
The commission could conciliate certain dismissal disputes without first deciding whether a dismissal occurred, and decide specified contested cases without a hearing when parties consent.
A separate income threshold for regulated road transport contractors would be set by regulation, governing access to unfair termination and unfair contract protections.
changes: Unfair deactivation and termination claims could be dismissed for being frivolous or vexatious, or having no reasonable chance of success.
A Full Bench could require permission for specified further applications following certain dismissals.
Repeat supported bargaining authorisations would use a streamlined pathway for substantially the same employers and employees.
Road Transport Advisory Group members would become eligible for travel allowances.
The National Construction Industry Forum would include the minister responsible for skills and vocational education.
summary.affected: Workers, employers, regulated road transport contractors, bargaining organisations, commission staff and industry advisory body members are affected.
